title: Architecture Sync — 2024-03-20
content:
Architecture Sync — 2024-03-20

Attendees: Engineering team

Agenda:

  1. JWT rotation RFC review
  2. ADR-002 status update
  3. API Gateway rate limiting design

Notes

JWT Rotation

RFC-001 was approved. Implementation starts this sprint (AUTH-1).

Key decisions:

  • 15-minute access token lifetime ✅
  • 7-day refresh token in HttpOnly cookie ✅
  • 30-second grace window for concurrent requests ✅

Action item: @you to start implementation by EOW.

Event Sourcing

ADR-002 approved. ULID-based append-only events table.

Compression job design still needed — assigned to INFRA team.

Rate Limiting

Sliding window algorithm chosen over token bucket for more predictable behavior under burst load.

Redis sorted sets for the sliding window implementation.

Action item: API-1 to be started next sprint.

Decisions

  • AUTH-1 implementation review by 2024-03-27
  • Schedule load testing for rate limiter before release
